Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! The players have made their way out to the middle. Max O'Dowd and Stephan Myburgh will open the batting for Netherlands. Wesley Madhevere will begin with the ball. Let's go!
... THE RUN CHASE ...

Netherlands were asked to bowl first and they have done a tremendous job once again. Their bowling attack continues to cause all sorts of trouble even to one of the strongest teams in the tournament. They might have not started on the right foot but they fought back exceedingly well and demolished Zimbabwe's batting line-up! It's been a collective bowling performance. All the bowlers chipped in with at least one wicket. Logan van Beek though was the leader of the pack, as he ended with 3 wickets. The Dutchmen can fancy their chances of winning the trophy here! Can they do so? We will find out. Stay tuned for the second essay!

After electing to put runs on the board first, Zimbabwe came out to bat with some positive intent. They started scoring runs right from the word go! Although they lost wickets at regular intervals, the run rate remained on the higher side. They dominated the Powerplay as they scored 52 runs for the loss of two wickets. After losing another wicket in the 7th over,  Sean Williams and Sikandar Raza put on a steady partnership and put the Dutch under the pump. But once that stand was broken, Zimbabwe were all over the place. From 93 for 3, they were reeling at 111 for 7 and eventually were bowled out for a mere 132! Only two of their batters scored over 20 runs. It's been a disastrous batting collapse and they now face a tough task ahead!

Scott Edwards will be thrilled by his team's bowling performance! At the toss, he did mention he wanted to bat first, but he will definitely be happy with how the scoreboard stands at the halfway mark of the match, while Zimbabwe will be disappointed with how things have ended, considering the fiery start they got!

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Zimbabwe have wasted three precious balls. Fred Klaassen delivers it on a good length outside off, Wellington Masakadza aims for a wild slog across the line but it takes the outside edge and flies into the gloves of Scott Edwards. The finger goes up immediately and Zimbabwe are all out for 132.
Commentary.Howout: c Scott Edwards b Fred Klaassen

Commentary.Commentary: Another short delivery, this time Richard pulls it to deep square leg and gets a single.
Short in length, around middle and off, Wellington Masakadza pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Richard Ngarava is the last man in. Also, Fred Klaassen comes to bowl the final over of the innings!

OUT! PLUMB LBW! Paul van Meekeren fires in a full ball, around middle and leg, Luke Jongwe attempts to heave it through the leg side by clearing his front leg. He misses and is rapped on the pads. An easy decision for the umpire.
On a length and around middle, Wellington Masakadza helps it towards mid on for a run.
Make it three in a row. A length ball outside off, Wellington Masakadza again goes for a mighty heave but doesn't connect.
Another swing and a miss! Short this time, outside off and angling away, Masakadza stands back and tries to power it over the leg side but misses.
Play and a miss! On a length and wide outside off, Wellington Masakadza throws his bat at it but fails to connect.
Slower one, short and around off, Luke Jongwe winds up for a big shot across the line but misses. He is hit on the body and the ball deflects to backward point. They cross for a leg bye.

Logan van Beek delivers it on a length and outside off, Luke pushes at it and edges it wide of the keeper. The short third man fielder cuts it off and they cross. Logan van Beek is done with his spell, 4-1-18-3 are his outstanding figures.
Fullish and on middle, Wellington flicks it towards square leg for a run.
On a length, around off, Luke mistimes his shot next to the pitch and they pinch a quick run.
Around leg, it's tickled through square leg for a couple of runs. Funnily, the crowd is doing the calling. They want Jongwe to be switched on.
Short in length and outside off, Wellington Masakadza cuts it past the diving point fielder for a run.
Wellington Masakadza walks out to bat.

OUT! BURL IS RUN OUT! Massive blow to Zimbabwe, this will cost them at least 10-15 runs. Fuller in length and around off, Jongwe drives it strongly to wide long off and sets off for a single. Ryan Burl turns for the second run and is midway down the track but Jongwe turns his back and is ball-watching. Ryan had turned blindly, trusting his partner to answer the call and has nowhere to go. He tries to scoot back but before that Logan van Beek has fired the throw to the keeper who does the rest.
Commentary.Howout: run out (Logan van Beek / Scott Edwards)

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Finds the gap! Short in length and around off, Ryan Burl rocks on the back foot and pulls it nicely in the gap at deep mid-wicket. It bisects the two deep fielders and crosses the fence. 10 from the over, Zimbabwe will be hoping to finish on a high!
Shortish and around off, Luke Jongwe punches it through covers for a run.
Fred Klaassen comes from 'round the wicket and angles in a length ball around off, Luke moves back and pushes it towards the bowler.
Sliding down the leg side, it's tucked through square leg. Ryan takes the first run quickly, turns for the second run but it's not on.
Slower one, around off and a bit short in length, Ryan stands back and mistimes his shot back towards the bowler.
FOUR! Vital runs for the home team. A length ball around middle and leg, angling down, Ryan Burl tickles it fine and beats the short fine leg fielder.
Fuller and around off, Luke Jongwe drives it past the bowler but finds mid off. Fine over.
Luke Jongwe is the new batter in.

OUT! BOWLED! Nelson strikes. This superstition will never get old. Bas de Leede spears it in, full and around middle, Tony Munyonga clears his front leg to heave it over the leg side but misses it completely. The ball goes on to rearrange the stumps. Zimbabwe have just three wickets left now. Can they bat out their remaining 25 balls?
Digs it in short, around off, Burl pulls it with ease to deep square leg for a run. Nelson up for Zimbabwe.
Short and around off, Tony turns and heaves it off the inner half to deep backward square leg. Just a single.
Two dots now. Back of a length, around off, Tony Munyonga punches from the back foot to covers. Ryan has a word with his partner.
Play and a miss! Fuller in length and wide outside off, Tony steps down the track for a big shot but fails to connect.
Change in bowling. Bas de Leede returns for his third over. 1 for 17 from him so far.
Around off, on a length. Tony Munyonga pushes it towards cover for a single.
On a length, around middle. Tony Munyonga flicks it away towards deep mid-wicket for a brace.
Touch fuller now, around middle and off. Tony Munyonga looks to heave this but he gets an inside edge back onto his pads and towards the bowler.
Good-length delivery, on the pads. Ryan Burl flicks it towards square leg for a single.
A shorter one, around middle and leg. Tony Munyonga miscues his pull to mid-wicket. Only a single.
On a length, around middle. Ryan Burl pushes it off the back foot towards the left of the bowler. Logan fails to stop and they cross for a single.
Around middle, a fuller ball once again. Ryan Burl knocks it down to long on for a single. He retains the strike! Good over from Tim Pringle, he ends his spell, 4-0-21-1.
Slower through the air, outside off, fuller one. Tony Munyonga drives it through covers and takes a single.
Pitches it up again, around middle and leg. Ryan Burl leans forward and clips it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Tosses it up, full around middle and leg. Ryan Burl pushes it back to the bowler.
Loopy ball, on the pads, full in length. Tony Munyonga tucks it to mid-wicket and takes a single. 100 up for Zimbabwe!
A loopy ball, a tad short and outside off. Ryan Burl pushes it towards point for a single.

Chance of a run out! Fuller and on middle, Tony wrists it towards mid-wicket and sets off for a run. The fielder there makes a diving stop and has a shy at the striker's end. He misses and Tony Munyonga returns safely. A direct hit was needed. A double-wicket maiden for Logan van Beek.
Swing and a miss! Very full again, outside off. Tony Munyonga throws his bat at it but he fails to get any connection.
No hat-trick. Slightly short in length and outside off, Tony Munyonga stays back to push at it and nearly drags it on.
Who will face the hat-trick ball? It is going to be Tony Munyonga.

OUT! LBW! A body blow to Zimbabwe! Two wickets in two balls for Logan van Beek! What a turnaround this is! A length ball, nipping back in a tad, around middle and leg. Sikandar Raza walks across and tries to flick this one, but he misses and gets hit on his pads. A loud appeal for LBW and the umpire raises his finger. Raza trudges back. Logan van Beek is on a hat-trick now!
Ryan Burl is in next.

OUT! CAUGHT! Logan van Beek comes back into the attack and strikes straightaway! Milton Shumba departs without troubling the scorers much. A length ball, darting it on the pads. Milton Shumba steps down the pitch and looks to flick this on the leg side, but the ball goes off the leading edge and flies high towards the off side. Scott Edwards, the keeper, runs forward and takes a sharp catch to his left. Zimbabwe have lost half their side now.
Commentary.Howout: c Scott Edwards b Logan van Beek

Commentary.Commentary: On a length, around off. Milton Shumba blocks it out off the back foot.
Logan van Beek (1-0-5-1) comes back into the attack.
FOUR! Top shot! A loopy ball, full and outside off. Sikandar Raza drives tt firmly through covers for a boundary. 13 from the over, along with a wicket.
A fuller ball, around middle and off. Milton Shumba drives it straight back and the bowler fails to stop it cleanly. It rolls behind and they cross.
Milton Shumba is the new batter.

OUT! TAKEN! Sean Williams this time tries to go big but he holes out. Shariz Ahmad gets his first wicket of the game and Zimbabwe lose their fourth! A shorter ball, around middle. Sean Williams uses the depth of his crease and pulls this one, but he finds the fielder at deep mid-wicket. Bas de Leede grabs it safely.
Commentary.Howout: c Bas de Leede b Shariz Ahmad

Commentary.Commentary: Touch shorter now, around middle and off. Sikandar Raza tucks it towards square leg for a single.
SIX! Sikandar Raza goes big! A loopy ball, full and outside off. Sikandar Raza shimmies down the pitch and smokes it over long off for a maximum.
Full one, around middle and leg. Sean Williams knocks it down to long on for a single.
Shariz Ahmad is back on. He went for 13 runs in his first over.
Another couple! Shorter one this time, outside off. Sikandar Raza looks to pull this but the ball goes off his inner half towards the vacant mid-wicket region. Two runs taken! 7 runs off the over!
Paul van Meekeren pitches it up this time, outside off. Sikandar Raza leans forward and drives it through cover-point for a brace.
Pulls his length back now, around middle, Sean Williams pulls it towards deep mid-wicket and takes a single.
A similar delivery! Outside off this time. Sean Williams stays in his crease and once again dabs it towards the fielder at point.
Another length ball, nipping away a tad, around off. Sean Williams hangs back and taps it towards point.
On a length, around middle and leg. Sean Williams tucks it in the vacant square leg region and takes a couple of runs.
Paul van Meekeren is back on!
Drops it short and around leg, Sean pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a run. At the halfway mark, Zimbabwe are 78 for 3.
Flatter and on off, punched to sweeper cover for a run.
Short and around leg, Raza tries to pull but fails. It goes off his pads to the keeper.
Gets on the front foot to a full ball and defends it back.
Googly around middle, Raza stays back and keeps it out at the last moment to covers.
Loopy and full, around off, pushed to point.
Tim Pringle comes back into the attack. 1/14 in his two overs.
On a length and outside off, Sean slaps it through the line but finds the cover fielder.
FOUR! Bang! Fraction short in length, around off, Sean Williams hangs on the back foot and flat-bats it down the ground for a powerful boundary. No stopping it!
Back of a length, around off, Raza gets back to pull but doesn't time it well. Ends up dragging it to deep mid-wicket and picks up a single.
Wide! A wayward bouncer down the leg side, Sikandar allows it through to the keeper.
Digs it in short, around off, Williams pulls it with ease to deep square leg for a single.
Fuller in length and around off, Raza drives it through cover-point for a single.
Starts with a full ball around off, Williams uses the angle and eases it down to long on for a run.
Bas de Leede (1-0-8-1) comes back into the attack.
Shariz continues to bowl short. It's around leg and forced down to long on for one. 13 runs from the over, Zimbabwe are cruising with their run rate.
FOUR! Another pull shot and this time Williams finds the gap. A long hop, around off, Seam camps back and dismisses it with authority to the deep mid-wicket fence.
A googly, on the shorter side, Sean pulls it to wide long on and collects a brace.

FOUR! Blasted down the ground! Short in length and it's in the line around off, Williams rocks back and spanks it straight past the bowler for a cracking boundary down the ground. Nearly took the umpire along with his shot.
Flighted delivery, full and on off, Raza flicks it through square leg and opens his account with a single.
Flatter and quicker, around leg, Sean goes back and turns it through mid-wicket for a single.
Sikandar Raza comes to the crease. Also, Shariz Ahmad is introduced into the attack.

OUT! CAUGHT! Another wicket goes down. Zimbabwe are scoring runs at a good rate but losing quick wickets as well. This one is full and outside off, Wesley Madhevere tries to sweep but has to fetch it from far outside off. He fails to middle the shot and it flies off the top edge to deep mid-wicket. A simple catch for Logan van Beek near the boundary line.
Commentary.Howout: c Logan van Beek b Tim Pringle

Commentary.Commentary: Very full and around leg, it's knocked down to long on for a run.
Loopy and full, outside off, Sean tries to sweep but fails to connect.
Goes on the back foot and works it through mid-wicket this time. He picks up a single.
Sharp turn there, from around middle, it's worked to square leg.
Gets forward and pushes a full ball to covers.
Tim Pringle is back on!
Short and around off, pulled across the line but straight to the fielder at mid on. At the end of the Powerplay, Zimbabwe are 52/2.
On a good length, around middle and leg, Wesley Madhevere tickles it behind square leg for one.
Eases a full ball through covers for a single.
Short and on off, pulled to deep square leg for one. 50 up!
Tucks it around the corner and picks up a single.
Fuller and on off, it's worked gently in front of square leg for a single.
On a length, around middle and leg. Wesley Madhevere flicks it through mid-wicket for a single. He retains the strike.
Around middle and off, fraction short. Wesley Madhevere blocks it off the back foot.
FOUR! Lovely shot! Wesley Madhevere gets off the mark in style! A short ball, around middle and off. Wesley Madhevere gets on top of the bounce and pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
Wesley Madhevere walks in next.

OUT! LBW! Wickets in quick succession for Netherlands! Bas de Leede sends back Regis Chakabva! A set batter departs now! A length ball, around middle. Regis Chakabva goes for the switch hit this time but he misses and gets hit on his pads. A huge appeal for LBW, and the umpire raises his finger after taking his own sweet time. Another huge wicket for the Dutch!
On a length now, around middle. Sean Williams works it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Good fielding! Back of a length, around middle. Regis Chakabva pulls it firmly towards deep mid-wicket. The fielder there runs across to his right, dives, and makes a good stop. Only a single.
Wide! Down the leg side now, on a length. Regis Chakabva misses his tuck and a wide is called.
Bas de Leede begins with a length ball, attacking the stumps. Regis Chakabva makes room and cuts it towards the fielder at cover-point.
Bas de Leede to bowl now.
Another short ball, around middle, Regis Chakabva pulls it towards deep square leg for a single. He retains the strike!
Swing and a miss! Paul van Meekeren drops it short this time, around middle and leg. Regis Chakabva makes room and looks to pull this but he misses.
Another good-length delivery, on the thigh pad. Sean Williams tucks it towards deep backward square leg and takes a single.
On a length, darting it around the thigh pad. Sean Williams flicks it towards square leg. No run there!
Slightly short now, around middle and off. Regis Chakabva pulls this one towards deep mid-wicket. The ball falls short of the fielder there. Single taken!
SIX! Regis Chakabva greets Paul van Meekeren with a biggie! A fuller ball, in the slot, around off. Regis Chakabva tonks it high over long on for a biggie. A maximum to begin with!
Change. Paul van Meekeren is introduced into the attack.
On a length, around middle and off. Sean Williams blocks it out.
Sean Williams is the number 3 batter.

OUT! CLEANED HIM UP! Logan van Beek strikes in his first over! He gets rid of the Zimbabwe skipper here! A big wicket this for the Netherlands! A fuller one, around leg and nipping a bit towards the stumps. Craig Ervine makes room and looks to heave this over long on but he ends up playing all over it. The ball goes on to shatter the stumps. Zimbabwe lose their first wicket.
Full and around middle, Craig Ervine looks to flick this but he gets a leading edge towards cover-point.

Bye! Another full ball, outside off. Regis Chakabva goes for the wild swing but he misses. Craig Ervine leaves his crease and the batters sneak in a bye! A little fumble by the keeper allows it though!
FOUR! Cheeky from Regis Chakabva! A fuller one, outside off. Regis Chakabva shuffles across and scoops it towards fine leg for a boundary. Lovely shot!
Swing and a miss! On a length, outside off. Regis Chakabva stays in his crease and looks to heave this one but he misses it.
Wide! Logan van Beek serves this down the leg side. Regis Chakabva leaves it alone. Wide called!
Change in bowling. Logan van Beek replaces Fred Klaassen from this end.
FOUR! Runs are flowing for Zimbabwe! Loopy ball, full and around off. Craig Ervine slog-sweeps this towards deep mid-wicket for a boundary. 12 runs off the second over as well!
Tad shorter now, around middle. Regis Chakabva works it away towards mid-wicket for a single.
SIX! Oh, shot! Perfectly executed! Tosses it up, around middle. Regis Chakabva gets down on his knee and reverse-sweeps it over covers. It goes all the way for a biggie! First maximum of the innings!
Full and on middle. Regis Chakabva blocks it out off the front foot.
Pitches it up again, around middle and leg. Craig Ervine steps down the pitch and flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Tim Pringle begins with a loopy ball, full and around off. Craig Ervine makes room and drives it towards covers.
Who will bowl from the other end? It's going to be Tim Pringle.
Another one on the pads, on a length. Craig Ervine tucks it towards square leg and takes a single. 12 runs off the first over!
FOUR! Craig Ervine gets off the mark with a boundary! On the pads and full in length. Craig Ervine flicks it through square leg for a boundary. Good start for Zimbabwe!
Fred Klaassen sticks to his length as he serves another fuller ball, on middle. Craig Ervine pushes it back to the bowler.
Another fuller one, on the pads, tailing back in a tad. Regis Chakabva flicks it towards mid-wicket. Only a single this time!
FOUR! Lovely shot! Overpitched delivery, around off. Regis Chakabva shows the full face of the bat and drives it straight down the ground for a boundary at long off. First boundary of the innings!
Fred Klaassen begins with a fuller ball from over the wicket, around middle and leg. Regis Chakabva flicks it through square leg for a brace. Regis Chakabva and Zimbabwe are up and running!

All in readiness now! The two umpires have walked to the centre. The Dutch players are also spreading on the field. Regis Chakabva and Craig Ervine are the openers for Zimbabwe. Fred Klaassen, the bowler in form, will open the bowling for Netherlands. One slip in place. Let's play...

Netherlands (Unchanged Playing XI) - Stephan Myburgh, Max O'Dowd, Bas de Leede, Tom Cooper, Scott Edwards (C/WK), Teja Nidamanuru, Logan van Beek, Tim Pringle, Fred Klaassen, Paul van Meekeren, Shariz Ahmad.

Zimbabwe (Playing XI) - Regis Chakabva (WK), Craig Ervine (C), Wesley Madhevere, Sean Williams, Sikandar Raza, Milton Shumba, Tony Munyonga (In for Blessing Muzarabani), Ryan Burl, Wellington Masakadza, Luke Jongwe, Richard Ngarava.
TOSS - Zimbabwe have won the toss and they have elected to BAT first!

For the Dutch, it’s been their bowling unit that has been a real threat to the opposition. Fred Klaassen and Logan van Beek are the two who are leading the bowling attack and have been causing all kinds of trouble. But it will be a real test for them in the final since they face their toughest opponents. It’s a strong batting unit versus a lethal bowling attack! Get ready for an intriguing battle and stay tuned for the toss and other updates.
